summary: All 83 source files matched their recorded sizes and SHA-256 hashes, and all seven reported values reproduced. The correction concerns the registered model input. Every one of the 4,819,887 per-sample expression values matched GEO’s normalized linear matrix, and the registered edgeR fit treated eight of those columns as counts. The preprint reports 82 hypothalamic discoveries at adjusted P < 0.1. The registered output has zero among 18,698 published genes at that cutoff. The available evidence cannot explain the difference or establish gene-level concordance. The corrected proposal passed the ledger validator.
openIssues: Author contact remains necessary to identify the samples, exclusions, input count scale and signed contrast behind the 82 discoveries. The preprint and GEO give different weaning-weight cutoffs that could still select the same animals.
The cited supplement and a tested-gene table with signed effects, raw P values and adjusted P values remain unlocated.
